description: New files only, nothing wired in. RelationshipList.tsx exports RelationshipList ({projection, select}, same name and props as the MetaprojectView export) plus pure helpers groupRelationships / summarizeRelationships and a NodeKindBadge. It groups root-adjacent relationships into Incoming and Outgoing (h3 with count), then by relationship kind in METAPROJECT_EDGE_KINDS_V2 order (h4 with count), rows sorted by title; a row is a button with the neighbour's title, a node-kind text badge and its monospace path and calls select(id); edges between two non-root nodes form a 'Second step' group whose rows name both ends and offer quiet 'Open <title>' buttons for either end; at most two evidence lines plus 'and N more'; provenance digests are never shown; limited and empty states have messages. NodeDetailsPanel.tsx exports NodeDetailsPanel with exactly the plan.md props and isOpenSpecNode, plus markdownPreview. Header: kind badge with icon, close, h2 title, monospace path with a 'Copy path' icon button (lib/format copyText) and an inline 'Copied' / 'Could not copy' status. Facts (.info-section/.info-row): module, page type, status badge, line, and 'N incoming · M outgoing[ · limited]' from summarizeRelationships. One underline .tabs bar (Relationships default, Wiki, OpenSpec) with .tab-count counts and arrow/Home/End keys. Relationships body: loading row while null+pending, inline-banner alert + Retry (onRetry) on a problem, else RelationshipList with onSelect. A change of revealRelationships switches to Relationships and scrolls the body into view. Wiki/OpenSpec bodies carry over GraphNodePanel: linked documents from `documents`, suggested component page, preview of the first document, Open (first one primary, others ghost), pending/problem/Retry, EmptyState with Find (primary) and Draft (ghost), the unsupported-CLI message. Carried over: resize separator with pointer and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End, Escape to close, compact mode below an 820 px host. Docked it does not move focus; compact it is a right-anchored drawer (min(380px, 100% - 72px)) that focuses its close button and returns focus on close/unmount. markdownPreview drops front matter, headings, rules, tables, fenced code and metadata lines (Covers, Version, Type, Status, ...), strips blockquote, list, bold/italic (* and _), strike, link and backtick markers, prefers the first prose paragraph, caps at 360 chars. nodePanel.css holds only metaproject-details-* / metaproject-rel-* classes on top of shared .badge, .tabs/.tab/.tab-count, .info-section/.info-row, .activity-row, .btn/.btn-ghost/.btn-primary, .icon-btn, .inline-banner, .loading-row, .empty-state, .side-resize; tokens only, no raw colours.

The test 'direction, depth and type controls filter the accessible relationship list' asserts the old row text 'Guide → describes → Client' and 'Client → imports → Server'; the new RelationshipList renders grouped rows (title, badge, path) and second-step rows as 'Client imports Server' with 'Open Client' / 'Open Server' buttons, so these assertions need updating when T8 switches the import.
The .metaproject-node-panel / .metaproject-node-* / .metaproject-relations rules become dead once T8 removes GraphNodePanel and the old RelationshipList; the new components do not use them.

assumptions: The Relationships tab count is the number of listed edges (incoming + outgoing + second step); the Wiki count excludes the suggested component page; counts are hidden while their projection is null.
The aside keeps aria-label 'Graph node details' and the close button 'Close graph node details' so the explorer's existing tests and selectors keep working after T8.
A self-loop on the root counts once, as outgoing; an edge whose ends are not in the projection is left out (as the old list did).
